title: The Monty Hall Problem
tagline: Switch doors or stay? A game show puzzle that fooled a thousand PhDs.
description: Three doors, one car, two goats. In 1990 Marilyn vos Savant said you should switch, and ten thousand angry letters said she was wrong. Play the game, run the numbers, and see why she was right.
coverAlt: Three cartoon doors, one slightly open with a goat peeking out
